runtime.sample: uniform reservoir over all test S1; seed 816
runtime.includes: Query reading, blocking, two-stage scoring, candidate/match shard writing and merging. Existing indexes/caches reused.
runtime.excludes: One-time cache copy, final official validation, and any slowdown from laptop sleep or competing workloads.

verification: Four unit tests passed through the actual PowerShell runner.

The cascade preserved every final audit prediction at pool 1000.
The delivered pool 300 was selected using calibration, then evaluated separately on the audit.
limitations: This is a training-data audit, not a leaderboard result.
